name: Anna C. Jones
bioAdditions: The 1925 state death index lists "McGuire, Anna C.; 7765; Larksville; Jan. 2" (S1). In the 1880 census at Plymouth Township, Ann C. Jones, 15, born in England, lived with her Welsh-born father Edward F. Jones (miner) and English-born mother Margaret; her sisters Rose (13) and Mary (10, a servant) were also born in England, and her brother William J. was born in Pennsylvania in September 1879 (S2). The family therefore came over between about 1870 and 1879. Her son William's 1927 licence again gives her birthplace as England (S3).
